title: Q-CONFORM-did-it-work: ultrastable/did-it-work carries every machine-readable file of the conformance register, each valid
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** failure-audit detector `repo-conform` (daily, reads every repository of doctrine/fleet-map.json); tenant-sync's vendor-sync pull request in ultrastable/did-it-work
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation repoconform --remote ultrastable/did-it-work
**Status:** open

REPO-CONFORM-2 (Rowan, 2026-11-27): "Research and implement best practices for refactored repos for autonomous development. Must be AI/machine-readable and compatible with all open standards." ultrastable/did-it-work was created before doctrine/tenant-standard.json required the full conformance set (seed/autonomy/repo-conformance.json) and vendored its reader. Its own pull request carries what the core writes into a checkout of it: `python3 -m foundation tenantstd --normalize <checkout>` (the manifest into the schema's shape) and `python3 -m foundation tenantstd --scaffold <checkout> --slug did-it-work`, which write and render every file of the register and vendor vendor/ultrastable/tools/repoconform.py, surfaces.py and deprot.py with the register and the system schema. Until then the dated exception `conformance: pending` in doctrine/tenant-standard.json holds the tenant's own reading and prints every held finding.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation repoconform --remote ultrastable/did-it-work

**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.7 within 336 h (read by `python3 -m foundation specgate --report`; this item closing by its done check keeps the share of well-specified open items at or above today's reading)

**Out of scope:** relaxing a validator, editing a rendered file by hand, or removing the exception before the reading passes.
